# D06 线性映射的秩零化度定理

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D06Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性映射的秩零化度定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D06_1_1", "线性映射可能把一部分方向压到零，其余独立方向在像空间中保留下来。", "", tts_text="线性映射可能把一部分方向压到零，其余独立方向在像空间中保留下来。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"T:V\longrightarrow W,\quad \dim V=n", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D06_1_1")
        self.start_cue("D06_1_2", "当定义域有限维时，核的维数加像的维数等于定义域维数。", "", tts_text="当定义域有限维时，核的维数加像的维数等于定义域维数。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\dim\ker T+\dim\operatorname{im}T=\dim V", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D06_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D06Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性映射的秩零化度定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D06_2_1", "设核的维数为 k，先选核的一组基，再扩充为 V 的一组基。", "", tts_text="设核的维数为 k，先选核的一组基，再扩充为 V 的一组基。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"v_1,\ldots,v_k,v_{k+1},\ldots,v_n", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D06_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D06_2_2", "前 k 个基向量的像都是零。任意向量按这组基展开，因此后 n 减 k 个向量的像张成像空间。", "", tts_text="前 k 个基向量的像都是零。任意向量按这组基展开，因此后 n 减 k 个向量的像张成像空间。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\operatorname{im}T=\operatorname{span}(Tv_{k+1},\ldots,Tv_n)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D06_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D06_2_3", "若这些像的线性组合等于零，则原来的组合属于核。", "", tts_text="若这些像的线性组合等于零，则原来的组合属于核。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"\sum_{i=k+1}^{n}c_iTv_i=0\Rightarrow\sum_{i=k+1}^{n}c_iv_i\in\ker T", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D06_2_3")
        self.start_cue("D06_2_4", "而核由前 k 个基向量张成，基向量线性无关，所以后半部分系数全为零。", "", tts_text="而核由前 k 个基向量张成，基向量线性无关，所以后半部分系数全为零。")
        self.play(FadeOut(line_1), FadeOut(line_2), FadeOut(line_3), run_time=min(0.35, self.cue_time_left()*0.15))
        line_4 = MathTex(r"c_{k+1}=\cdots=c_n=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_4, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_4), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_2_4", heading=heading, line1=line_4)
        self.end_cue("D06_2_4")
        self.start_cue("D06_2_5", "于是这 n 减 k 个像构成像空间的一组基，像的维数为 n 减 k。", "", tts_text="于是这 n 减 k 个像构成像空间的一组基，像的维数为 n 减 k。")
        line_5 = MathTex(r"\dim\operatorname{im}T=n-k", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_5.next_to(line_4, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_5), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_2_5", heading=heading, line1=line_4, line2=line_5)
        self.end_cue("D06_2_5")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D06Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性映射的秩零化度定理", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D06_3_1", "例题：从三维空间到二维空间，映射把第三个坐标丢弃，求核和像的维数。", "", tts_text="例题：从三维空间到二维空间，映射把第三个坐标丢弃，求核和像的维数。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"T(x,y,z)=(x,y)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D06_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D06_3_2", "核由第三个坐标方向张成，维数为一；像是整个二维空间，维数为二。", "", tts_text="核由第三个坐标方向张成，维数为一；像是整个二维空间，维数为二。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"\ker T=\operatorname{span}\{(0,0,1)\}", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D06_3_2")
        self.start_cue("D06_3_3", "验证维数之和等于三。", "", tts_text="验证维数之和等于三。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"1+2=3", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_3_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D06_3_3")
```

        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D06_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D06_4_1")
